title: Clarify 20-character limit for assignable permission set names
summary: Documentation clarifies that assignable permission sets must not exceed 20 characters in name, a stricter limit than the general 30-character object naming rule, with compiler error AL0305 enforcing this at build time.
key_points: Assignable permission sets have a 20-character name limit, not the general 30-character limit
Non-assignable permission sets still follow the 30-character limit
The 20-character limit is a build-time compiler error (AL0305), not just a publish-time finding
Includes best practice showing full names with prefix/affix must fit 20 characters
Anti-pattern added showing 21-30-character assignable permission set names
